_doc: Gold labels for test/calibration/tiles.json, merged from two blind, independent labellings (test/calibration/labellers/) by scripts/calibration/merge-labels.mjs. remove/removeAll: rule set B refs. A: the same for rule set A (starter rules). E: rule set A with R3 relabelled by two more blind labellers (labellers/getrich-labeller{1,2}.json) for the intent "get-rich-quick hype only", merged the same way. Their definition: MATCH = get-rich-quick money hype: the video promotes or promises fast or easy money (crypto coin pumps or price hype, trading signals, bots or systems sold as easy profits, day-trading-for-a-living or 'I made $X in a day' hype, passive-income or side-hustle schemes promising quick income, gambling or betting 'systems'). NO MATCH = videos that explain, teach, analyse, report news on, review, debunk or critique crypto, trading, investing or personal finance, ordinary business, career or money-saving advice, and everything unrelated. E.unsure: a labeller marked the R3 answer unsure (counted as given). keep/keepAll: rule set C refs. ambiguous / keepAmbiguous / A.ambiguous / E.ambiguous: the labellers disagreed; such Tiles are excluded from headline metrics and reported apart.
